text:
Viktor Arvidsson signed in Detroit as a free agent and has been one of the good things about a bad stretch. Eight goals and 15 points in 19 games, and his chances are the best on the team: 9.96 expected goals.

Right now he's pointless in four and goalless in six, with 3.3 expected goals in those four games. That's a drought the chances say should end, and the Red Wings have scored five fewer goals than expected with him on the ice. If you're looking for a player due a bounce, this is him.

The style hasn't changed since Nashville. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 99th percentile for chances from the slot last season, carrying the puck in on 58% of his entries. Evolving-Hockey had him 47th of 401 forwards in wins above replacement. At 33, on his fifth team, he's still a top-six scorer. Our range: 26 to 43 goals.
